title: Warm Portuguese Cannellini Bean Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew featuring cannellini beans, inspired by Portuguese flavors and cooked to perfection in an iron teppan, this dish is perfect for a lazy Sunday, it is also buddhist temple friendly as it does not contain any animal products
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the iron teppan over medium heat
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Add the cannellini beans, vegetable broth, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
Stir in the lemon juice and continue to simmer for an additional 5 minutes
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired
